description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectVideoIPCObject operation in the object detection (objectdet) category
description_zh: 本文为您介绍目标检测（objectdet）类目下的IPC视频目标检测DetectVideoIPCObject的语法及示例
name: DetectVideoIPCObject

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video file. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频文件URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the actual start time of the video. For example, if the video starts at 12:00 on August 16, 2021, the corresponding timestamp is 1629086400
parameters.help_zh: 视频实际开始时间的时间戳。例如视频开始时间是2021年8月16日12:00，对应时间戳为1629086400
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter callback messages. Valid values:

true: The callback is triggered only when objects are detected in the input video.
false: The callback is triggered regardless of whether objects are detected
parameters.help_zh:
是否回调消息过滤。

true：如果输入的视频中检测到有目标，才会执行回调，否则不执行。
false: 无论是否检测到有目标，都执行回调
parameters.name: callback_only_has_object

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Frames.description_en: The collection of video frames. Frames without detected objects are not listed
Frames.description_zh: 视频帧的集合，未检测到目标的帧不列出

Elements.description_en: The collection of detected objects. This field is empty if no objects are detected
Elements.description_zh: 检测到的目标集合，如果没有目标则为空

Height.description_en: The height of the detection box, in pixels

Score.description_en: The confidence score of the detection box. Value range: [0.0, 1.0]
Score.description_zh: 检测框的置信度，取值范围为[0.0,1.0]

Type.description_en:
The name of the object corresponding to the detection box. Valid values:

PERSON: person
VEHICLE: vehicle
PET: pet
Type.description_zh:
检测框对应的物体名称。取值如下：

PERSON：人
VEHICLE：车辆
PET：宠物

Width.description_en: The width of the detection box, in pixels

X.description_en: The X-coordinate of the upper-left corner, in pixels
X.description_zh: 左上角X轴坐标，单位像素

Y.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the upper-left corner, in pixels
Y.description_zh: 左上角Y轴坐标，单位像素

Time.title_en: 视频帧时间，startTimestamp+视频帧的相对时间的值，单位毫秒，如果startTimestamp为空，则是相对时间
Time.title_zh: 视频帧时间，startTimestamp+视频帧的相对时间的值，单位毫秒，如果startTimestamp为空，则是相对时间

Frames.title_en: 视频帧的集合，未检测到目标的帧不列出
Frames.title_zh: 视频帧的集合，未检测到目标的帧不列出

Height.description_en: The height of the video, in pixels
Height.description_zh: 视频高度分辨率，单位像素
Height.title_en: 视频文件的分辨率(像素)
Height.title_zh: 视频文件的分辨率(像素)

Width.description_en: The width of the video, in pixels
Width.description_zh: 视频宽度分辨率，单位像素
Width.title_en: 视频文件的分辨率(像素)
Width.title_zh: 视频文件的分辨率(像素)

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
